{{Update|[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]}}
'''Tangle guns''' were nonlethal capture devices that were produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]] for crowd control. These weapons fired plastic webbing that was used to incapacitate a target; in this regard they were similar to [[Spray stick/Legends|Stokhli spray sticks]], though without the secondary gas dispenser.
